shorts.title: $20,000 in Pokémon Cards Gone Before Sunrise 🚨
shorts.description: Early Wednesday morning burglars hit two Pokémon card shops in Los Angeles. Around 4 AM three suspects smashed into Gary's Pokémart in Woodland Hills and took about $20,000 in cards. About an hour and 40 minutes later PokeMall in Pico Robertson got hit, but this time police got there and two suspects were arrested. Should card shops be doing more to protect their stock, or is it on police to stop

shorts.title: $480,000 to $232,000 in Under 7 Weeks 😳 Gold Star Pikachu
shorts.description:
A PSA 10 Gold Star Pikachu from 2006 Holon Phantoms sold for $480,000 on September 27. Then $360,000, then $264,000, and on November 12 one sold on Alt for $232,133. But back in April a PSA 10 sold on Goldin for $93,940, so it's still worth more than double. Is this the dip to buy, or is the Gold Star bubble popping? 👇
#pokemon #pokemontcg #pikachu #pokemoncards #thecardwall

shorts.title: $260 Million in Pokémon Card Sales This Year 🤯
shorts.description: UltraBall tracked every Pokémon card that sold for $100,000 or more in 2026. Through November 23 there were 894 of them, worth $260.8 million, and 29 sold for over $1 million. The biggest was the Pikachu Illustrator at $16.5 million. Goldin alone had 127 sales over $100,000 through mid November, compared to just 3 in the same stretch last year. shorts.title: $78,000 to $33,000 in One Month 😳 Gold Star Charizard
shorts.description:
On October 15 a PSA 9 Gold Star Charizard from 2006 Dragon Frontiers sold for $78,000. On November 15, three PSA 9s sold for $32,100, $33,000 and $33,099. But a PSA 10 went from $65,600 last December to $504,000 in October. Would you chase a Gold Star Charizard right now, or wait for it to cool off? 👇
#pokemon #pokemontcg #charizard #pokemoncards #thecardwall

shorts.title: $24,000 for a PSA 5 Gold Star Rayquaza 😳
shorts.description:
Four Gold Star Rayquaza cards from EX Deoxys sold in one day on Monday for a combined $102,000. A BGS 8.5 went for $29,400, two BGS 8s went for $27,600 and $21,000, and a PSA 5 still pulled $24,000. But back in September a BGS 8.5 sold for about $53,000. Would you pay $24,000 for a Gold Star, or wait for prices to keep falling? 👇
#pokemon #pokemontcg #rayquaza #pokemoncards #thecardwall

shorts.title: $113,000 of Solid Gold Pokémon Cards 🤯
shorts.description:
Pokémon China just revealed 30 Pikachu cards made of 99.9% pure gold, one for every Pikachu in the 30th Celebration set. 30 grams each, about $3,765 in gold per card. But you can't buy them. Would you buy one, or is it just a flex? 👇
#pokemon #pokemontcg #pikachu #pokemoncards #thecardwall

shorts.title: $1,450 To $898. Pokémon Prices Are Falling Fast.
shorts.description:
The biggest modern Pokémon chase card, the Umbreon ex from Prismatic Evolutions, sold for $1,450 in September. Today on eBay it's going for $898.
 
And it's not just Umbreon. The Mega Rayquaza ex from Delta Reign hit $398 on release day. Two weeks later, $284. The 30th Celebration Night box went from $724 to $350.
 
Some collectors are calling it a crash. Others are calling it the best buying wind

shorts.title: $630,000 For A Pokémon Card That Was Never Released
shorts.description:
In 1998, before Pokémon cards came to America, Wizards of the Coast made a special galaxy holo Blastoise to pitch the game to Nintendo. It's one of only two known Blastoise presentation cards.

On Friday, this one in a CGC 8.5 sold on Fanatics for $630,000 after 59 bids, a new record for any Blastoise card.

shorts.title: $990,000 For One Charizard. And That Might Be A Discount.
shorts.description:
On Friday, a 1st Edition Shadowless Charizard in a PSA 10 sold on Fanatics for $990,000 after 27 bids.

shorts.description:

shorts.description:

shorts.title: This Pokémon Card Lost $16,600 in 2 Months
shorts.description:
The first blue RGB Mew from Pokémon 30th Celebration sold for $20,000 on eBay before the set even hit shelves. Collectors thought the card was a hoax. Now the same blue Mew sells for about $3,400. Was $20,000 the top, or is $3,400 the steal of the year?

#pokemon #pokemoncards #pokemontcg #rgbmew #30thcelebration
